talk.text: Wait. Is that a giant circle cut into the wall?
Yep! It's Louis Kahn's library at Phillips Exeter Academy, from nineteen seventy-one, and outside it's a plain brick box.

label.name: The atrium
label.meta: Books stacked around a central atrium

talk.text: A huge central atrium, with the books stacked all around it.
Ooh, what's that sweeping stair by the door?
A curved travertine double staircase, right at the library entrance.

label.name: The carrels
label.meta: Reading carrels at the brick edge

talk.text: And where do people actually sit to read?
Along the brick edge, in little carrels beside the windows.
